components.name: Site Navigation
components.description: Sticky limestone masthead with quiet centered desktop links and a compact mobile dropdown.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-header { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 20; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr; align-items: center; min-height: 82px; padding: 0 clamp(1.25rem, 5vw, 5.25rem); border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(41 39 34 / 20%); background: #eee9e0; color: #292722; } .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .8rem; width: fit-content; color: inherit; font: 1.16rem 'Playfair Display Variable', Georgia, serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-mark { display: grid; width: 2.45rem; aspect-ratio: 1; place-items: center; border: 1px solid #927656; border-radius: 50%; color: #793f3b; font: .9rem 'Playfair Display Variable', Georgia, serif; } .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: clamp(1.6rem, 3.2vw, 3.6rem); } .ds-nav a, .ds-header-note { color: inherit; font: .76rem 'Outfit', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .045em; } .ds-nav a { padding: .5rem 0; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a::after { display: block; width: 100%; height: 1px; margin-top: .3rem; background: currentColor; content: ''; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 260ms cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1); } .ds-nav a:hover::after, .ds-nav a:focus-visible::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible, .ds-brand:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #793f3b; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-header-note { justify-self: end; color: #555148; } @media (max-width: 900px) { .ds-header { grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; min-height: 74px; } .ds-header-note { display: none; } .ds-nav { position: absolute; top: 100%; right: 0; left: 0; display: none; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; gap: 0; padding: .5rem clamp(1.25rem, 5vw, 5.25rem) 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(41 39 34 / 20%); background: #eee9e0; } .ds-nav.is-open { display: flex; } .ds-nav a { padding: 1rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(41 39 34 / 20%); font-size: .9rem; } }

components.name: Primary Collection Link
components.description: Direct anchor into the collection passage, not a purchase action.
components.html: Découvrir la collection
components.css: .ds-collection-link { display: inline-flex; width: fit-content; min-height: 3.4rem; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1.35rem; padding: .2rem .05rem .2rem 1.15rem; border: 1px solid #793f3b; border-radius: 0; background: #793f3b; color: #f5f2eb; font: .84rem 'Outfit', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 220ms ease, color 220ms ease; } .ds-collection-link svg { margin-right: 1rem; } .ds-collection-link:hover { background: transparent; color: #793f3b; } .ds-collection-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #793f3b; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-collection-link { min-height: 3.15rem; } }

components.name: Secondary Passage Link
components.description: Unfilled text link with a fine bronze underline and a restrained directional icon.
components.html: Découvrir la maison
components.css: .ds-text-link { display: inline-flex; width: fit-content; min-height: 2.6rem; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1.35rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #927656; color: #292722; font: .82rem 'Outfit', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-text-link svg { color: #793f3b; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1); } .ds-text-link:hover svg { transform: translate(3px, -3px); } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #793f3b; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Entry Plaque
components.description: Open-bottom arched frame around the lead collection statement and its link.
components.html:
Vêtements de créateur.

Découvrez la collection Maison Sillage au fil de ses passages.

Découvrir la collection
components.css: .ds-plaque { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: flex; width: min(100%, 33rem); min-height: 28rem; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: flex-start; padding: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 4rem) clamp(.4rem, 2.1vw, 2rem); color: #292722; } .ds-plaque::before { position: absolute; z-index: -1; top: 0; right: 1.6rem; bottom: 0; left: 1.6rem; border: 1px solid rgb(146 118 86 / 42%); border-bottom: 0; border-radius: 50% 50% 0 0 / 20% 20% 0 0; content: ''; } .ds-plaque h1 { max-width: 8ch; margin: 0; font: 400 clamp(3.2rem, 5.3vw, 5.4rem)/.98 'Playfair Display Variable', Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -.035em; } .ds-plaque p { max-width: 31ch; margin: 1.6rem 0 2rem; color: #555148; font: .98rem/1.75 'Outfit', sans-serif; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-plaque { min-height: 0; padding: 2.3rem 1.5rem 2.7rem; } .ds-plaque::before { right: 0; left: 0; border-radius: 50% 50% 0 0 / 17% 17% 0 0; } }

components.name: Editorial Figure
components.description: Unrounded fashion photograph with a small explicit inspiration caption.
components.css: .ds-editorial-figure { position: relative; min-width: 0; margin: 0; } .ds-editorial-figure img { display: block; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: .97; background: #d4c8b9; object-fit: cover; } .ds-editorial-figure figcaption { margin-top: .7rem; color: #555148; font: .68rem 'Outfit', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .035em; }

components.css: .ds-maison { padding: clamp(5rem, 10vw, 9rem) clamp(1.25rem, 8vw, 8rem); background: #37332e; color: #f5f2eb; } .ds-maison-frame { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(240px, .75fr); align-items: end; gap: 2rem 5vw; padding-top: 2rem; border-top: 1px solid rgb(238 233 224 / 30%); } .ds-maison-frame h2 { margin: 0; font: 400 clamp(3.4rem, 8vw, 7.5rem)/.98 'Playfair Display Variable', Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -.045em; } .ds-maison-frame p { max-width: 40ch; margin: 0 0 .4rem; color: #e2d9cb; font: 1rem/1.75 'Outfit', sans-serif; } .ds-light-link { grid-column: 2; display: inline-flex; width: fit-content; min-height: 2.6rem; align-items: center; gap: 1.35rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #927656; color: #f5f2eb; font: .82rem 'Outfit', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-light-link svg { color: #d4bb9b; } .ds-light-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d4bb9b; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-maison-frame { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 1.4rem; } .ds-maison-frame .ds-light-link { grid-column: 1; } }

narrative.overview:
Maison Sillage's homepage is an editorial sequence of thresholds: a fashion image and collection invitation, a two-image collection passage, then a quiet Maison sign-off. Warm limestone, a dark iron section, oxblood action, and restrained bronze framing give the page its architectural character. The desktop and mobile captures confirm this hierarchy, with the lead image paired with the collection plaque on wider screens and placed above it on narrow screens.

The current implementation uses real font files for Outfit and Playfair Display Variable, but its three remote Unsplash photographs are explicitly labeled as inspiration, not Maison Sillage product imagery. No catalog, prices, availability, provenance, or craftsmanship story is represented. The brief mentions textured glass, but no glass surface or texture is implemented in the inspected CSS or captures; this document records the shipped limestone-and-iron treatment instead.
keyCharacteristics: A warm, restrained palette with oxblood reserved for the main collection action.
Playfair Display headlines paired with Outfit navigation, labels, and body copy.
Editorial image framing and a single arched plaque establish passage-like architecture.
Responsive layouts preserve the image-to-copy sequence and direct collection navigation.

rules.name: The Passage-Link Rule
rules.body: Keep the collection invitation a clear, directly usable link; the arch is framing, not a replacement for the action.

rules.name: The Editorial Pairing Rule
rules.body: Keep Playfair Display Variable for large editorial titles and Outfit for functional navigation, captions, and prose.

dos: Do retain the limestone / pale limestone / iron surfaces and the current oxblood action contrast.
Do use the collection anchor as a clear passage into the collection section.
Do keep the mobile sequence image first, then the entry plaque and collection content.
Do preserve visible focus outlines and reduced-motion behavior.
Do identify the current photographs and collection status as inspiration or unfinished where shown.
donts: Don't present inspiration imagery as actual Maison Sillage products.
Don't invent product names or details, prices, availability, provenance, craft claims, testimonials, or commerce flows.
Don't document textured glass, shadow cards, rounded product cards, or other treatments as shipped; they are not present in the inspected implementation.
Don't turn the styled collection anchor into an implied purchase or checkout action.
